title.en: Aquatic browsing and giant terrestrial browsing comparison
title.zh: 水栖取食与巨型陆栖取食比较

description.en: A reproducible entry point for comparing two richly described lineages without treating the interface as a phylogenetic result.
description.zh: 用于比较两个具有丰富档案的谱系的可复现入口；界面本身不构成系统发育结论。

limitations: Comparison fields inherit each claim, range and occurrence source boundary; visible differences are not tests of evolutionary causation.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Perissodactyla time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的奇蹄类时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Perissodactyla interval in the diversity view to inspect bundled sample counts, not an estimate of total richness.
description.zh: 在多样性视图中打开有来源边界的奇蹄类区间，检查包内样本计数，而不是总体丰富度估计。

limitations: Counts are derived from the bundled, bounded occurrence sample and do not estimate total diversity, preservation-corrected richness, or a complete taxon range.
